login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to your office workspace.

signup.title: Create your office account
signup.subtitle: Set up your office in one step. You can invite your team afterwards.
signup.maybeCreated: Your office may already have been created. Try signing in.

passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with upper- and lower-case letters and a digit.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for this address, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
resetPassword.invalidBody: Reset links can be used once and expire after one hour. Request a new one.

verifyEmail.successBody: Thank you. Your account is fully active.
verifyEmail.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
verifyEmail.invalidBody: Confirmation links can be used once and expire after 7 days. Enter your email to get a new one.
verifyEmail.resentBody: If this address has an unconfirmed account, a new link is on its way.

notice.idle: You were signed out after a period of inactivity.
notice.expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
notice.passwordReset: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new password.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.countdown_one: For your security, you will be signed out in {{count}} second.
idle.countdown_other: For your security, you will be signed out in {{count}} seconds.
